title: Check four network predictions
description: You compare a forward pass with target values at four inputs.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You arrange 15, -5, 3, and 8 as a single input column. The first matrix multiplication and bias produce the hidden-layer values.
You apply relu and then the output layer. z2_test holds one predicted output per test input.

steps.question: Do the recorded inputs -5 and 3 produce the same prediction when their actual values both equal 16?
steps.answer: Their predictions differ. The target function gives 16 for both.

steps.description: You print each prediction beside its target to four decimal places. The recording also compares the predictions with 256 at x=15 and 81 at x=8.
